purpose: Verify voice consistency / volume stability / pause naturalness / cn-en code-switching on 200-350 char passages
deployment: Modal A10G GPU, chatterbox-poc app, edwardt0303 namespace
voice_ref_source: Azure Edge TTS zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural (Xiao Yu, same as previous short-test)
voice_clone: zero-shot from prompt mp3 (native Chatterbox API)

evaluation_criteria_for_edward.voice_consistency: Does the voice stay the same person from start to end?
evaluation_criteria_for_edward.volume_stability: Any sentence noticeably louder or quieter than rest?
evaluation_criteria_for_edward.cn_en_mixing: Do English tech terms pronounce correctly?

samples.text: Edward、跟你報告今天城堡的進度。沙利曼那邊已經把 Taiwan-Tongues 跟 VibeVoice 兩家的隱私審查跑完了、verdict 給的是 Tier B 條件式可用、Phase 2 PoC 階段沒問題、Phase 4 對外商用前要找律師再審一次。霍爾的 v3 計畫書也 ship 了、補上雙模型路由跟家庭多語對話兩段、字數壓在兩千五百以下。卡西法那邊正在跑 Chatterbox-Turbo 第二輪長文測試、會跟前面四家 voice profile 對比、預計兩小時內你就能聽到完整結果。我這邊已經把 5 月 22 號這場 sprint 的所有決策都寫進 ADR-018 跟 ADR-019、紀律檔也補了「中國公司開源 model 本機跑分 Tier」這條 cross-product 規矩、未來城堡所有產品都能繼承。今天就這些、你想討論哪個再叫我。
samples.truncation_post_verified: file size 1920044 bytes matches dur 40.0s * 24000 Hz * 2 bytes = 1920000 expected, full content rendered

samples.text: 今天真的有點累、從清晨開始追進度、技術選型來回好幾輪、聲音工具盲測踩了好幾個坑、normalize 跟 inference 入口配置都修了。但收穫也明顯、找到聯發科 Taigi 系列、發現沙利曼的 cross-product Tier 矩陣需要升級、Chatterbox-Turbo 真的可能比 Edge TTS 更自然。明天我們再決定 Phase 2 主路怎麼走、今天先把這些先存著、別急。

你那個 BeyondPath 的 dashboard 我看過、retention 數據看起來沒問題、但 conversion funnel 那邊的 stage 3 drop 比較明顯、可能要派蕪菁頭去看 user behavior。另外 PR 那條我已經跑過 lint 沒問題、merge 之前再跑一次 e2e test 就可以 ship 到 main。BeyondPath 2.0 的 spec 你想什麼時候開始？

heuristic_note: truncation_warning uses conservative 6 chars/sec lower bound. Chatterbox actual pace 5-10 chars/sec. Verify by file size: duration_sec * 24000 * 2 bytes should equal wav file size. All 3 confirmed not truncated.

post_run_stability_assessment.verdict: all 3 calls produced full audio matching char count expectation; truncation_warning on L01 is false positive from conservative heuristic
